idea-plugin.name: Marp Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Live preview for Marp slide decks, right next to the Markdown editor, in every JetBrains IDE.

Open a Markdown file whose front matter contains marp: true and it gets an Editor / Split / Preview toggle. The preview refreshes while you type, no save needed.

Features

  • Live preview rendered by marp-core inside the IDE's built-in browser (JCEF). No Node.js, no Marp CLI, no external process.
  • Scroll sync in both directions, the slide under the caret is highlighted, double-click a slide to jump to its source line.
  • Custom themes from CSS files, folders or URLs (the same entries as markdown.marp.themes in VS Code), plus automatic pickup of themeSet from .marprc.yml. Theme edits show up live.
  • Local images with relative paths, ![bg](...) backgrounds, fitting headers, Twemoji.
  • Math with MathJax (works offline) or KaTeX.
  • Inline HTML in slides: off, Marp's safe allow list, or all. Untrusted projects render without HTML and without remote themes.
  • The preview follows the IDE light or dark theme. Links open in the IDE (project files) or in the system browser.

Settings: Settings | Tools | Marp.

Marp Preview is an independent project and is not affiliated with the Marp team.
